svg.title: DLGN: sparse differentiable logic network and hard gate export
svg.desc: An illustrated schematic: a pixelated image becomes a vector of bits, passes through a sparse network of actual Boolean gate symbols and class-group score bars. Lower magnification shows a gate learning a mixture of 16 operator probabilities and discretizing to a selected Boolean gate while preserving the same two input wires. Bars and image are schematic, not measured data.

g.text: Fixed sparse wiring · Learnable operator mixtures · Discrete Boolean execution
Argmax export to one Boolean operator
Soft mixture → discrete gate ID · connectivity retained
Illustrative architecture and operator probabilities; not experimental measurements.
